bio.text: Andre Baker, a Democrat, has represented Connecticut House District 124 since January 7, 2015.

According to Ballotpedia, he was born in New Rochelle, New York, lived in Bridgeport as of September 2019, and earned an associate degree in mortuary science from the State University of New York at Farmingdale in 1986.

He owns Baker-Isaac Funeral Services and Baker Funeral Services, was elected to the Bridgeport Common Council in 2005 and served eight years, and was elected to the Bridgeport Board of Education in 2013.
